key_grammar.point: 부정어(구) 문두 도치 (Not only ~ but also)
key_grammar.source_sentence: Not only are our sensory systems organized to detect change, but they are most tuned to stimuli that are unexpected and surprising.

explanation.text: 부정의 뜻을 지닌 Not only가 문장 맨 앞에 오면 주어와 (조)동사의 자리가 바뀐다.
Not only + 동사 + 주어 ~, but (also) + 주어 + 동사 ~ 의 형태가 된다.
Not only are our sensory systems organized ~ 에서 be동사 are가 주어 our sensory systems 앞으로 도치되었다.
Not only A but (also) B 상관구조로, 뒤 절 but they are ~ 와 호응한다.
도치는 앞 절에서만 일어나고, but 이하 they are ~ 는 정상 어순이다.

key_grammar.example_analysis: 부정어구 Not only가 문두에 와서 be동사 are가 주어 our sensory systems 앞으로 도치되었다.

drills.question: 다음 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 적절하지 않은 것은?
drills.sentence: Not only [[1|is]] our sensory systems [[2|organized]] [[3|to detect]] change, but they are most tuned to stimuli [[4|that]] [[5|are]] unexpected and surprising.
drills.fix: is → are. 주어 our sensory systems가 복수이므로, Not only 도치 구문에서도 be동사는 원문대로 are여야 한다.

drills.question: 각 네모 안에서 어법에 맞는 것을 고르시오.
drills.sentence: When you move your body and [[produce/producing]] tactile sensations, these stimuli are [[less/least]] noticeable to you than [[are/is]] sensations produced by another individual.
drills.fix: move와 병렬을 이루는 produce, 두 대상을 비교하는 비교급 less, 도치된 뒤 주어 sensations(복수)에 맞춘 are가 옳다.

drills.question: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
options: This differential response to surprising tactile stimuli appears to be a defense mechanism that has adaptive significance.
Our enjoyment of being tickled generally diminishes as we age.
It is probably also the reason why being tickled by someone else is more effective at produce an emotional reaction than trying to tickle yourself.
Likewise, your reaction to your cat jumping onto your lap is likely to be much greater if you have your eyes closed when it happens.
This is likely due to the fact that adults are better at anticipating stimuli, and hence are more difficult to surprise, than are children.
drills.answer: It is probably also the reason why being tickled by someone else is more effective at produce an emotional reaction than trying to tickle yourself.
drills.fix: produce → producing. 전치사 at의 목적어이므로 원문대로 동명사 producing이 되어야 한다.

drills.question: 그는 열심히 공부할 뿐만 아니라, 다른 학생들도 돕는다. (Not only로 시작할 것)
drills.answer: Not only does he study hard, but he also helps other students.

drills.question: 우리의 감각계는 변화를 감지하도록 구성되어 있을 뿐만 아니라, 예상 밖이고 놀라운 자극에 가장 잘 맞춰져 있다.
drills.answer: Not only are our sensory systems organized to detect change, but they are most tuned to stimuli that are unexpected and surprising.

sentences.english: Not only are our sensory systems organized to detect change, but they are most tuned to stimuli that are unexpected and surprising.

misreads.statement: 네가 스스로 만든 촉각 자극이 남이 준 감각보다 더 뚜렷하게 느껴진다.
misreads.anchor: these stimuli are less noticeable to you than are sensations produced by another individual
misreads.why: 자기 몸이 만든 자극이 남이 준 것보다 덜 뚜렷하다고 했다.

sentences.english: The sensations of your own legs touching one another when you cross your legs, for example, are generally less noticeable than a similar touch on your leg would be if someone sitting next to you brushed their leg against yours.

grammar.note: your own legs touching one another(서로 닿는)
if ... brushed ~, would be(현재 사실 반대의 가정)

[[if someone sitting next to you brushed their leg against yours.]]

misreads.why: 덜 뚜렷하다는 결론은 맞지만, 접촉 세기 때문이 아니라 스스로 유발한 자극이기 때문이다.

mistips: than a similar touch ~ would be if ~ brushed는 'would+동사원형 ~ if+과거동사'의 가정법 과거 구조이다.
